justification: Image A depicts a carved stele with rows of human figures, hieroglyphic-style signs, and boats arranged in horizontal registers, while image B depicts a single crouching quadrupedal creature (with clawed feet and a curled tail) alongside footprints, carved in relief on an architectural block. There is no shared iconographic motif—no common figure type, animal, object, or symbol—between the two, only the loose commonality that both are figural relief carvings on stone.'
